title: Feedback Passed to Engineering
summary: Most fragments are administrative notes about feedback being passed along or customers having no further input, with only one clearly positive example and little substantive detail on vehicle experience.

positive.summary: The only positive fragment reflects a dashboard indicator concern being described without an explicit complaint and is too limited to support broader conclusions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly document feedback routing to engineering, lack of additional customer input, or miscellaneous administrative mentions without clear sentiment about the vehicle.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are service or administrative statements rather than direct evaluations of the vehicle.
The cluster mixes feedback-routing notes, absence of customer feedback, documentation comments, and unrelated 'passed' mentions, so topical coherence is limited.
The single positive example is too sparse to identify concrete recurring strengths.
